The target is a skill runner that needs the Claude login (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN), and no workflow in .github/workflows has a schedule trigger, so no scheduled entry exists. The repository has no tags, releases or release workflow (gh release list and git ls-remote --tags are empty), so the release tier is a published GitHub release that framework CI setup creates. One live run is about 270 agent calls (15 steps, 6 arms, 3 trials) at about 3 hours, which rules out pull_request and push. The skill ships by clone, so no publish or deploy job exists to gate. The held-out partition lives outside the repository in a mode-0700 state directory the agent cannot read, so it runs on the operator's machine through evals/lab/prepare_held_out.py and has no CI entry.
